title: KASNEB Open Learning — Implementation Register
content:
KASNEB Open Learning — implementation checkpoint

12 October 2026. Full programme incomplete; Wave 1 remains in progress.

Production work verified

  • Open Learning hub published.
  • CA35P, DD31, DD32, DD24 and CA15 free settings preserved. All five public pages previously verified Free + Enroll Now; authenticated acceptance remains pending.
  • Fourteen CA35P lessons moved from final topic 1530 into modules 1523–1529. IDs and lesson content preserved. Each of Modules 1–7 now has two lessons; course total remains eighteen.
  • CA35P course description and visible curriculum summary corrected to match the structure and disclose incomplete verification.
  • Eight topic labels corrected to remove unverified syllabus claims and premature consolidation labels.
  • Backups: datalytiqs_kasneb_free_access_snapshot_20261012; datalytiqs_kasneb_structure_snapshot_20261012; datalytiqs_kasneb_topic_labels_snapshot_20261012.

Curriculum and sources

13 qualification listings and 173 paper/other requirement identities recorded. This is a partial inventory, not a complete syllabus denominator. Official August 2026 timetable corroborates identities and explicit sitting-specific durations; future sitting requirements are not inferred.

Current CPA webpage and official April/August 2026 timetables corroborate CA35P. Booklet CA36P discrepancy remains in audit history. Retain CA35P; no identifier migration.

Canonical full JSON and lesson traceability are preserved in draft PR 69. WordPress option datalytiqs_kasneb_curriculum_register_v1 stores the equivalent compact register: apply paper_defaults and resolve source_id through sources. All 143 existing lessons have traceability records; official topic mappings, PDFs and independent academic review remain pending.

Original content and PDFs

DraftPagesStatus
DD31 Python syntax — v1.1.19Draft; not published
DD31 data preparation, validation and joins — v1.0.08Draft; not published
CA15 descriptive statistics — v1.0.08Draft; not published

Total: 25 pages of independently authored notes with worked examples, guided practice, solutions, original questions and synthetic cases. Review copies retained. Canonical HTML/PDF compiler produces searchable tagged PDFs, language metadata, bookmarks, contents links and clickable references. All final layouts rendered and inspected. Full PDF/UA conformance remains unverified.

Technical quality assurance

19 unit tests pass. Coverage includes independent variance checks, financial arithmetic, exact-duplicate versus conflicting-ID handling, duplicate lookup rejection, malformed amount rejection, missing-versus-zero behaviour, row/value reconciliation, corrupt-asset recovery, version immutability and concurrent-worker idempotence.

Synthetic practical: nine raw transaction rows = one duplicate + two quarantined + six admitted. Net total KES 7,500; Office A 5,200, Office B 2,300. No genuine learner or institutional data used.

Management deliverables

  1. Curriculum register — partial identities and source scopes.
  2. Qualification/paper inventory — 13 listings, 173 requirements.
  3. Traceability — 143 existing lessons, official mapping pending.
  4. Content production — three substantive drafts.
  5. PDF register — three reviewed technical-layout drafts, zero new published syllabus PDFs.
  6. Assessment register — original draft questions and tested objective-scoring utility.
  7. Lab integration — existing checkpoint links; authenticated evidence acceptance pending.
  8. Free access — settings and public UI verified; full learner journey pending.
  9. Academic QA — independent academic/originality review pending.
  10. Learner acceptance — authenticated synthetic journey and isolation pending.
  11. Defects — full syllabus sources, Tutor API credential boundary, review and acceptance gates.
  12. Publication readiness — zero full courses accepted under the new standard.

Authentication diagnosis

Tutor REST routes call RestAuth::process_api_request and require dedicated Tutor API credentials; the WordPress connection does not satisfy this authentication. No credential expansion or security weakening performed. Supported WordPress bridge operations remain available.

Continuation

Daily continuation remains enabled around 08:00 Africa/Nairobi. Resume this current checkpoint and PR 69; use current records rather than the initial 55-record/one-draft snapshot. Resolve full source editions, academic review and authenticated learner/Lab testing while continuing original content production. Do not claim complete syllabus coverage from existing shells or brief companions.
